CodexExecConfig.description:
codex-unified-exec config shape.

The only codex setting is the host-repo `enabled` gate (not a codex semantic). It lives as a `codexExec` sub-section of the pi-processes config so it is edited through the single /ps:settings command rather than a separate settings command. Codex's runtime caps are constants, not settings (see ../constants).

enabled.description: When true, the extension creates its own ProcessManager instance and registers the unified_exec tools. Defaults to false.

shellPath.description: Absolute shell executable used to run process commands.

autoHideOnFinish.description: Hide process log interfaces when all managed processes finish.

enabledByDefault.description: Open process log interfaces in follow mode by default.

blockBackgroundCommands.description: Block shell background patterns and redirect the agent to the process tool.

defaultTailLines.description: Default number of recent lines returned by the process output action.

maxOutputBytes.description: Maximum bytes retained by each process log interface.

maxOutputLines.description: Maximum lines retained by process log interfaces.

ProcessConfig.description: User-facing pi-processes settings stored on disk.

$schema.description: JSON Schema URL used by editors for validation and autocomplete.

processList.description: Process overview and log viewport settings.

version.description: Config migration marker written after v0.10.0 settings migration.

maxPreviewLines.description: Maximum log rows displayed in the overview preview and logs overlay.

maxVisibleProcesses.description: Maximum process rows displayed in the overview before scrolling.

dockDefaultState.description: Initial visibility of the process dock.

dockHeight.description: Number of log rows displayed in the expanded process dock.

showStatusWidget.description: Show a one-line process summary below the editor.
